description: You are inside the general store.  All sorts of items are stacked on shelves behind the counter, safely out of your reach. A small note hangs on the wall.
npcs: A grocer stands at the counter, with a slightly impatient look on his face.

description: You are on the main street crossing through town.  To the north is the general store, and the main street continues east.  To the west you see and hear the market place, to the south a small door leads into the Pet Shop.
The Pet Shop is a small crowded store, full of cages and animals of various sizes.  There is a sign on the wall.
npcs: There is a Pet Shop Boy standing here cuddling something furry in his hands.
